item.title: New abilities for Legends: Z-A Megas, and Pokémon Champions release date

br.p:
Pokémon Champions, the battle-focused Switch game, has been announced to be released on April 8th. It will be available on mobile at a later date. Along with this, abilities for new Mega Evolutions from Legends: Z-A were announced:
Mega Meganium has a new ability Mega Sol, which uses moves as if the weather was harsh sunlight (without that weather being active for the whole field). Mega Emboar has the ability Mold Breaker. Mega Feraligatr has a new ability Dragonize, which turns Normal-type moves into Dragon-type moves.

item.title: New games Pokémon Winds & Pokémon Waves announced!

description.p:
A new Pokémon Presents has just aired, announcing a brand new pair of Pokémon games - Pokémon Winds & Pokémon Waves! They will be released next year, 2027, exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2. The new region appears to be made up of several islands; the official site describes an open world to explore, with beautiful windswept islands and a vast ocean with glittering waves that ebb and flow.
The three First Partner Pokémon were briefly introduced in the trailer:
Browt, the Bean Chick Pokémon - Grass type Pombon, the Puppy Pokémon - Fire type Gecqua, the Water Gecko Pokémon - Water type
Also in the Pokémon Presents, Mega Garchomp Z was officially revealed. Trailer and screenshots below.

item.title: Pokémon Rosso Fuoco e Verde Foglia saranno ripubblicati su Switch e Pokémon Presents in arrivo

br.p: This coming Friday, February 27th, will be Pokémon Day! This is the annual celebration that marks the original release of Pokémon Red & Green in Japan. There will be a Pokémon Presents with news about upcoming games, believed to include details of the next generation of Pokémon games! The Pokémon Company have also announced that the Game Boy Advance games, Pokémon FireRed & LeafGreen, will be released on the Nintendo Switch following the Pokémon Presents. item.title: Mega Lucario Z revealed for Legends: Z-A DLC

br.p:
È uscito un nuovo trailer che rivela un'ulteriore megaevoluzione per Lucario: Mega Lucario Z. Sarà disponibile nel DLC Mega Dimensions per Pokémon Legends: Z-A. Ecco il trailer:
Mega Lucario Z rimane di tipo Lotta/Acciaio. Questa forma è elencata come Z Mega Evolution, che richiede meno tempo per eseguire le mosse ma consuma Mega Power molto rapidamente. È stata annunciata anche una missione secondaria per ottenere Mewtwo e le sue mega pietre. È disponibile dal menu Link Play > Regalo misterioso > Ottieni tramite Internet.

item.title: Mega Zeraora revealed

br.p:
A new trailer for the Legends: Z-A DLC has been released and reveals a new Mega Evolution: Mega Zeraora. It remains Electric type.
Description from official info: Zeraora has incredibly high aptitude to begin with, but typically it has an internal limiter that works to contain the electric energy stored within its body. It’s thought that Mega Evolution removes this limiter. It's stated that getting Mega Zeraora might be a little difficult, so it may be a more involved quest during the DLC rather than a simple Mystery Gift.

item.title: Mega Chimecho e Mega Baxcalibur rivelati nei nuovi trailer del DLC Mega Dimension

description.p:
Three new trailers have been released for Pokémon Legends: Z-A. The first two deal with the paid DLC, which is announced to be releasing on December 10th. During this DLC, Hoopa opens up portals to Hyperspace Lumiose, a parallel world in which different Pokémon can be found, including several from newer games like Scarlet/Violet.
There are also new Mega Evolutions. Mega Raichu X and Mega Raichu Y were seen previously, and this trailer also reveals Mega Chimecho and Mega Baxcalibur. Continue below for the trailer videos.

L'ultimo Nintendo Direct è andato in onda e ha rivelato cinque nuove megaevoluzioni per Pokémon Legends: Z-A. I primi tre sono gli starter originali di Kalos di Pokémon X&Y: Chesnaught, Delphox e Greninja. Questi non sono i Pokémon Primo Partner in Legends: Z-A ma possono essere catturati durante il gioco. Le loro Mega Pietre si ottengono dalle Battaglie Classificate. Ecco il trailer:

item.title: Pokémon Presents rivela Mega Dragonite e altre funzionalità

description.p:
A new Pokémon Presents has just aired, with many news snippets as well as a new game announcement and futher news on the upcoming Pokémon Legends: Z-A, which will be released October 16, 2025. The biggest news was the reveal of Mega Dragonite!
During the story of LZA, you will join Team MZ who protect Lumiose. As revealed previously there is a tournament Z-A Royale that takes place at night, and there appears to be an evil team called the Rust Syndicate. As in the original X/Y games there is a big fashion focus and trainers can change their hairstyle and clothing. Like Legends: Arceus, there are many side quests where you can help out other characters around the city, and do research on Pokémon. Another strand is Rogue Mega Evolution, where wild Pokémon have been Mega-Evolving on their own and you must quell them. Among them is Mega Dragonite, which takes on features of Dragonair such as its small wings and pearl on its tail.

item.title: Rivelato il torneo Z-A Royale per Legends: Z-A

br.p: A Nintendo Direct has aired and featured some Pokémon news. After a short recap of earlier info, it's revealed that at night trainers come out to battle in a tournament called the Z-A Royale. In special zones, similar to wild zones but marked in red, if a trainer sees you they will challenge you to battle. You can also sneak up on a trainer or their Pokémon, similar to taking wild Pokémon by surprise in Legends: Arceus. In the tournament, trainers start at rank Z and work up to rank A. item.title: Generation 8 Pokémon and Dynamax coming to Pokémon GO

description.p:
Niantic have announced a large update to Pokémon GO, bringing the release of Generation 8 along with the Dynamax feature from Pokémon Sword & Shield. It will start September 3rd with the season, titled Max Out.
New Pokémon will be released in the wild: Grookey, Scorbunny, Sobble, Dreepy, and Stonjourner (UK only). Morpeko was also announced previously but it's not clear when it will be released. It will bring a change to battles, with it being able to change form like the main series games. With the new event starting on the 3rd, Skwovet and Wooloo (which were released a while back) will also appear and can be shiny. Niantic decided to release very little information about how Dynamax will work in GO. But so far we know that from September 10th, mysterious Power Spots will appear in which players can battle Dynamax Pokémon. A new substance Max Particles can be collected at Power Spots to take them on. Only Pokémon caught from Max Battles can be Dynamaxed. Bulbasaur, Charmander, Squirtle, Skwovet, Wooloo will be the first battles available.

item.title: New Mythical Pokémon Pecharunt officially revealed

br.p:
Un nuovo trailer è stato rilasciato da The Pokémon Company, che annuncia ufficialmente il mitico Pokémon Pecharunt. È Veleno/Fantasma e ha una nuova abilità Burattinaio Velenoso che fa confondere anche i Pokémon avvelenati.
Pecharunt è disponibile durante l'epilogo del pass di espansione Scarlet/Violet. È stato anche rilasciato un video aggiuntivo che racconta la storia di Pecharunt, vedi sotto.
